activity.notes: John Carver was chosen or confirmed as governor immediately after the Mayflower Compact in 1620 and served as Plymouth Colony's first governor until his death in April 1621.

sources.title: Leadership & Governance in Plymouth Colony — Pilgrim Hall Museum
sources.citation_text: Pilgrim Hall Museum identifies John Carver as Plymouth Colony's first governor, chosen immediately after the Mayflower Compact, and records his death in April 1621.

sources.title: John Carver Biography — American Ancestors
sources.citation_text: American Ancestors records Carver as governor from the landing at Plymouth until his death in April 1621.
